challenges.desc:
Share an #easyrecipe for Singapore's local food! 10 mouthwatering entries will stand to win $100 NTUC FairPrice vouchers each. 😋🎉

From 7 to 27 May 2021, post a recipe on TikTok carrying the hashtags #easyrecipe to participate in the contest. Entries must include a cuisine representing Singapore's cultural food or local dish. Applicable for Singapore residents only. 

Need more ideas? Explore more recipes rich with uniquely Singaporean flavours here! https://go.gov.sg/shf2021-moap

[Contest in partnership with Singapore HeritageFest]
